description: Reduced original-line excerpts for inspection and smoke tests; not full training datasets or reproduced benchmark results.

sampling.algorithm: uniform Algorithm R reservoir with uniform byte-safe subsampling
sampling.line_indices: one-based physical original lines, retained in original order
sampling.byte_policy: Preserve exact original bytes. Skip lines larger than max_bytes. Uniformly reduce the reservoir to at most floor(max_bytes / largest_eligible_line_bytes).
sampling.source_discovery: All recursive project *.jsonl files and only the named early collection files that exist.
sampling.validation: Counts describe sampled physical rows only. Original malformed JSON and malformed user-state strings are preserved without repair; diagnostic wrappers are not training examples.
